tools.name: chargebee_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, newest first. Filter by email or creation time. Chargebee API: GET /customers.

tools.name: chargebee_get_customer
tools.description: Retrieve a single customer by id. Chargebee API: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: chargebee_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions. Filter by customer or status. Chargebee API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: chargebee_get_subscription
tools.description: Retrieve a single subscription by id. Chargebee API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: chargebee_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices. Filter by customer or status. Chargebee API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: chargebee_get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice by id. Chargebee API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: chargebee_list_items
tools.description: List Product Catalog 2.0 items (plans, addons, charges). Filter by type. Chargebee API: GET /items.

tools.name: chargebee_list_item_prices
tools.description: List Product Catalog 2.0 item prices. Filter by item. Chargebee API: GET /item_prices.

tools.name: chargebee_list_transactions
tools.description: List payment/refund transactions. Filter by customer. Chargebee API: GET /transactions.

tools.name: chargebee_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes. Filter by customer. Chargebee API: GET /credit_notes.

tools.name: chargebee_create_customer
tools.description: Creates a customer in Chargebee (additive). Chargebee auto-generates the id unless you pass one. Chargebee API: POST /customers.

tools.name: chargebee_update_customer
tools.description: Updates a customer's details in Chargebee. Chargebee API: POST /customers/{customer_id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chargebee_list_customers · Public sink: chargebee_list_customers, chargebee_create_customer, chargebee_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chargebee_list_customers · Public sink: chargebee_list_customers, chargebee_create_customer, chargebee_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
